{{Top}}
'''Crodium''' was a hard precious metal that was first discovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Crollia]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Crodium was used in the early spacecraft that traveled via the [[hyperspace cannon]], though was rarely used in modern shipbuilding. Crodium was also mined on [[Terephon]] used in making security fences. It was refined to plate other metals. If exposed to the elements for too long, it could tarnish.
